§dPurpose and mechanism§r
Keep a Dense State Steam Manipulator controller in your inventory to complete this non-consuming check. The machine converts steam fluid grades, with a §11000:1§r ratio for dense steam. Configure inputs, modes, and outputs according to its information.

§3Preparation and operation§r
This goal checks a fluid-conversion controller rather than singularity possession or a completed compression recipe. Decide between compression and decompression when building, then check fluid grades and storage capacity on both sides. Volume conversion does not create a new steam source. Align input, mode, and downstream consumers before planning the complete supply route.
